}

```js
import axios from 'axios';
import { auth } from './firebase';

const baseURL = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3000').replace(/\/$/, '');

export const api = axios.create({ baseURL: `${baseURL}/api` });

api.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
  const user = auth.currentUser;
  if (user) {
    try {
      const token = await user.getIdToken();
      config.headers = config.headers || {};
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    } catch (_) { /* proceed without token */ }
  }
  return config;
});

export function apiError(err, fallback = 'Something went wrong') {
  return err?.response?.data?.error || err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || fallback;
}

**src/lib/toast.jsx**:
```jsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useRef, useState } from 'react';

const ToastContext = createContext({ toast: () => {} });

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const toast = useCallback((message, type = 'info') => {
    const id = ++idRef.current;
    setToasts((t) => [...t, { id, message, type }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts((t) => t.filter((x) => x.id !== id)), 4000);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ toast }}>
      {children}
      <div className="toast-wrap" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {toasts.map((t) => (
          <div key={t.id} className={`toast toast-${t.type}`}>{t.message}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() {
  return useContext(ToastContext);
}
```

**src/lib/auth.jsx**:
```jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { onAuthStateChanged, signInWithPopup, signOut as fbSignOut } from 'firebase/auth';
import { auth, googleProvider } from './firebase';
import { api } from './api';

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children, role }) {
  const [firebaseUser, setFirebaseUser] = useState(null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [verifyError, setVerifyError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (u) => {
      setFirebaseUser(u);
      setVerifyError(null);
      if (u) {
        try {
          const idToken = await u.getIdToken();
          const { data } = await api.post('/auth/verify', { idToken, role });
          setProfile(data);
        } catch (err) {
          setProfile(null);
          setVerifyError(err?.response?.data?.error || err?.message || 'Failed to verify account');
        }
      } else {
        setProfile(null);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return unsub;
  }, [role]);

  const signIn = useCallback(async () => {
    await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
  }, []);

  const signOut = useCallback(async () => {
    await fbSignOut(auth);
    setProfile(null);
  }, []);

  const value = {
    firebaseUser,
    user: profile?.user || null,
    role: profile?.role || null,
    expectedRole: role,
    profile,
    loading,
    verifyError,
    signIn,
    signOut,
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  return useContext(AuthContext);
}
```

export function formatINR(value) {
  const n = Number(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(n)) return '—';
  return `₹${n.toLocaleString('en-IN', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
}

```jsx
import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

export function RequireAuth({ children }) {
  const { firebaseUser, loading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  if (loading) return <Loading text="Checking your session…" />;
  if (!firebaseUser) return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location }} />;
  return children;
}

export function RoleWarning() {
  const { role, expectedRole, verifyError } = useAuth();
  if (verifyError) return <div className="banner banner-error">{verifyError}</div>;
  if (expectedRole && role && role !== expectedRole) {
    return (
      <div className="banner banner-warn">
        Your account role is “{role}”. {expectedRole} features may be limited until your account is granted the “{expectedRole}” role.
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
}
```

export function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const s = String(status || 'unknown');
  const map = { placed: 'amber', requested: 'amber', pending: 'amber', accepted: 'blue', packed: 'violet', picked: 'violet', delivered: 'green', approved: 'green', rejected: 'red', cancelled: 'red' };
  return <span className={`badge badge-${map[s] || 'gray'}`}>{s}</span>;
}

import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';

  { to: '/', label: 'Shop', end: true },
  { to: '/products', label: 'Products' },
  { to: '/orders', label: 'Orders' },
];

  return (
    <RequireAuth>

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, apiError } from '../lib/api';
import { useToast } from '../lib/toast';
import { Loading, EmptyState, RoleWarning } from '../lib/components';

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [shops, setShops] = useState(null);
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.get('/shops', { params: { mine: 'true' } });
      const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.shops || [];
      setShops(list);
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load your shops'), 'error');
      setShops([]);
    }
  }, [toast]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  async function toggleOpen(shop) {
    setToggling(shop.id);
    try {
      await api.put(`/shops/${shop.id}`, { ...shop, is_open: !shop.is_open });
      toast(shop.is_open ? 'Shop marked closed' : 'Shop is now open', 'success');
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not update shop'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setToggling(null);
    }
  }

  if (!shops) return <Loading text="Loading your shop…" />;

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <RoleWarning />
      {shops.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card center-card">
          <h2>Set up your shop</h2>
          <p className="muted">Create your shop profile to start selling to customers nearby.</p>
          <Link className="btn btn-block" to="/shop/new">Create shop</Link>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {shops.map((shop) => (
            <div className="card" key={shop.id}>
              ...
            </div>
          ))}
          <Link className="btn btn-outline" to="/shop/new">Add another shop</Link>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

ProductForm — the biggest file. Let me sketch:

```jsx
export default function ProductForm() {
  const { id } = useParams(); // present in edit mode
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const isEdit = Boolean(id);

  const [shops, setShops] = useState([]);
  const [shopId, setShopId] = useState(searchParams.get('shop') || '');
  const [method, setMethod] = useState('manual'); // 'ai' | 'barcode' | 'manual'
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', category: '', description: '', price: '', stock: '', image_url: '' });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEdit);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false);
  const [scanPreview, setScanPreview] = useState(null);
  const [scanFile, setScanFile] = useState(null);
  const [barcode, setBarcode] = useState('');
  const [lookingUp, setLookingUp] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingImage, setUploadingImage] = useState(false);

  // load shops
  useEffect(() => { api.get('/shops', { params: { mine: 'true' } }).then(...) }, []);
  // load product when editing
  useEffect(() => { if (isEdit) api.get(`/products/${id}`).then(...) }, [id]);

  function update(field, value) { setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [field]: value })); }

  async function handleScanFile(e) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setScanFile(file);
    setScanPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
  }

  async function analyzeWithAI() {
    if (!scanFile) return toast('Choose or capture a product photo first', 'error');
    setScanning(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('image', scanFile);
      const { data } = await api.post('/scan/ai', fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } });
      setForm((f) => ({
        ...f,
        name: data.name || f.name,
        category: data.category || f.category,
        description: data.description || f.description,
      }));
      toast('Details filled from AI scan', 'success');
      setMethod('manual'); // jump to form to review? Or stay. I'll switch to form tab labelled 'Review & save'. Actually keep tabs; switch to manual to show fields.
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'AI scan failed'), 'error');
    } finally { setScanning(false); }
  }

  async function lookupBarcode(code) {
    if (!code) return;
    setLookingUp(true);
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post('/scan/barcode', { code });
      if (data?.found) {
        setForm((f) => ({ ...f, name: data.name || f.name, image_url: data.image || f.image_url, description: data.brands ? `Brand: ${data.brands}` : f.description }));
        toast('Product found via barcode', 'success');
        setMethod('manual');
      } else {
        toast('Product not found for that barcode — fill details manually', 'info');
      }
    } catch (err) { toast(apiError(err, 'Barcode lookup failed'), 'error'); }
    finally { setLookingUp(false); }
  }

  async function uploadImage(e) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setUploadingImage(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', file);
      const { data } = await api.post('/upload', fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } });
      if (data?.url) { update('image_url', data.url); toast('Image uploaded', 'success'); }
    } catch (err) { toast(apiError(err, 'Image upload failed'), 'error'); }
    finally { setUploadingImage(false); }
  }

  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!shopId) return toast('Select a shop first', 'error');
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        shop_id: shopId,
        name: form.name.trim(),
        category: form.category.trim() || null,
        description: form.description.trim() || null,
        price: Number(form.price),
        stock: form.stock === '' ? undefined : Number(form.stock),
        image_url: form.image_url || null,
      };
      if (isEdit) await api.put(`/products/${id}`, payload);
      else await api.post('/products', payload);
      toast(isEdit ? 'Product updated' : 'Product added', 'success');
      navigate(`/products?shop=${shopId}`);
    } catch (err) { toast(apiError(err, 'Could not save product'), 'error'); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  ...
}

Barcode camera scanning component (BarcodeScanner) within ProductForm file or separate. I'll write a separate small component file `src/pages/BarcodeScanner.jsx`? Keep inside ProductForm as a function component defined in same file:

```jsx
function CameraBarcodeScanner({ onDetected, onClose }) {
  const videoRef = useRef(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let stream;
    let timer;
    let cancelled = false;
    async function start() {
      try {
        if (!('BarcodeDetector' in window)) { setError('Camera barcode scanning is not supported on this device. Enter the code manually.'); return; }
        const detector = new window.BarcodeDetector({ formats: ['ean_13', 'ean_8', 'upc_a', 'upc_e', 'code_128', 'qr_code'] });
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment' } });
        if (cancelled) return;
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        await videoRef.current.play();
        timer = setInterval(async () => {
          try {
            const codes = await detector.detect(videoRef.current);
            if (codes && codes.length > 0) { onDetected(codes[0].rawValue); }
          } catch (_) {}
        }, 600);
      } catch (err) { setError('Could not access the camera. Enter the code manually.'); }
    }
    start();
    return () => { cancelled = true; if (timer) clearInterval(timer); if (stream) stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop()); };
  }, [onDetected]);
  ...
}
```

const KEY = 'lezzflow_cart_v1';

export function CartProvider({ children }) {
  const [cart, setCart] = useState(() => {

    catch { return { shopId: null, shopName: '', items: [] }; }
  });

  useEffect(() => { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(cart)); }, [cart]);

  function addItem(product, shop) {
    setCart((c) => {
      const sameShop = !c.shopId || String(c.shopId) === String(shop.id);
      const base = sameShop ? c : { shopId: shop.id, shopName: shop.name || 'Shop', items: [] };
      const existing = base.items.find((i) => String(i.product.id) === String(product.id));
      const items = existing
        ? base.items.map((i) => i === existing ? { ...i, qty: i.qty + 1 } : i)
        : [...base.items, { product, qty: 1 }];
      return { ...base, items };
    });
  }
  ...
}

The duplicated lib files (5 files × 4 = 20 listings) are unavoidable since each app must be independently buildable. I could reduce by using `frontend/shared` imported via vite alias... risk with builds outside root is actually fine since everything is within the monorepo root; vite allows serving files from the project root by default (it searches for workspace root). But apps are "independently buildable" — if shared sits outside app dir, building from within app dir still works because vite fs.allow defaults to workspace root search... `fs.strict` default true but allow list defaults to the "workspace root" detected by package.json lockfiles. With no root package.json, workspace root = app dir → importing ../../shared would fail fs.strict. So duplication is the safe route. Confirmed: duplicate.

Let me also double check axios + FormData: setting Content-Type multipart manually is fine (axios sets boundary automatically if we don't set header; setting 'multipart/form-data' without boundary can break in some environments — in browsers axios detects FormData and lets the browser set the header even if we passed one? If we explicitly set header, axios will not override... Actually axios v1: if data is FormData and header not set, it lets browser set. If we set 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data', the browser's XHR... axios uses XHR/fetch; with XHR, if you set content-type header manually without boundary, the request breaks. Safer: DON'T set the header; just pass FormData. axios will handle it. I'll omit headers for FormData posts.

.google-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 18px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); background: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink); }
.google-btn:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
.google-btn:disabled { opacity: .6; }

/* Choice cards (fulfillment etc.) */
.choice-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.choice { border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; background: #fff; text-align: left; }
.choice.active { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-50); }
.choice-title { font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 2px; }

/* Tabs */
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; background: #eef2f7; padding: 5px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.tab { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; padding: 9px 6px; border-radius: 9px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.tab.active { background: #fff; color: var(--green-dark); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }

/* Upload tiles */
.upload-tile { border: 1.5px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; text-align: center; background: #fff; }
.upload-tile.done { border-color: var(--green); border-style: solid; background: var(--green-50); }

/* Tables (admin) */
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: #fff; }
.table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; }
.table th { text-align: left; padding: 10px 12px; background: #f8fafc; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.table td { padding: 10px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
.stat-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .stat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } }
.stat-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 16px; }
.stat-num { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--green-dark); }

/* Doc links */
.doc-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.doc-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }

.cart-count { background: var(--green); color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 7px; margin-left: 6px; font-weight: 800; }
.scan-preview { width: 100%; max-height: 240px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 12px; }
.video-preview { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; background: #000; }

```jsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api, apiError } from '../lib/api';
import { useToast } from '../lib/toast';
import { Loading, EmptyState, StatusBadge, formatINR, asArray } from '../lib/components';

function nextAction(status) {
  if (status === 'placed') return { label: 'Accept order', next: 'accepted' };
  if (status === 'accepted') return { label: 'Mark as packed', next: 'packed' };
  return null;
}

export default function Orders() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.get('/orders');
      setOrders(asArray(data, ['orders']));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load orders'), 'error');
      setOrders([]);
    }
  }, [toast]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  async function advance(order, next) {
    setBusy(order.id);
    try {
      await api.patch(`/orders/${order.id}/status`, { status: next });
      toast(`Order #${order.id} updated to “${next}”`, 'success');
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not update order'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  if (!orders) return <Loading text="Loading orders…" />;
  if (orders.length === 0) return <EmptyState title="No orders yet">New orders from customers will appear here.</EmptyState>;

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      {orders.map((order) => {
        const action = nextAction(order.status);
        const items = asArray(order.items);
        const total = order.total_amount ?? order.total ?? order.amount;
        return (
          <div className="card" key={order.id}>
            <div className="row-between">
              <div>
                <strong>Order #{order.id}</strong>
                <div className="muted small">{formatDate(order.created_at)}</div>
              </div>
              <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
            </div>
            ...items, fulfillment, total, action button
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

formatDate helper in components.jsx:
```jsx
export function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return '';
  const d = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(value);
  return d.toLocaleString('en-IN', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
}

```jsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, apiError } from '../lib/api';
import { useToast } from '../lib/toast';
import { Loading, EmptyState, asArray } from '../lib/components';

const SECTIONS = [
  { key: 'within5km', title: 'Within 5 km' },
  { key: 'within10km', title: 'Within 10 km' },
  { key: 'within20km', title: 'Within 20 km' },
];

export default function Discover() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [coords, setCoords] = useState(null);
  const [locError, setLocError] = useState(false);
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState(null);
  const [manualLat, setManualLat] = useState('');
  const [manualLng, setManualLng] = useState('');

  const fetchShops = useCallback(async (lat, lng) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.get('/discover', { params: { lat, lng } });
      setGroups(data || {});
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not discover shops nearby'), 'error');
      setGroups({});
    }
  }, [toast]);

  const detect = useCallback(() => {
    setLocError(false);
    setGroups(null);
    if (!('geolocation' in navigator)) { setLocError(true); return; }
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        const c = { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude };
        setCoords(c);
        fetchShops(c.lat, c.lng);
      },
      () => setLocError(true),
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 12000, maximumAge: 60000 }
    );
  }, [fetchShops]);

  useEffect(() => { detect(); }, [detect]);

  function useManual(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const lat = Number(manualLat); const lng = Number(manualLng);
    if (Number.isNaN(lat) || Number.isNaN(lng)) { toast('Enter valid latitude and longitude', 'error'); return; }
    setLocError(false);
    setCoords({ lat, lng });
    fetchShops(lat, lng);
  }

  if (locError) {
    return (
      <div className="stack">
        <div className="banner banner-warn">We couldn’t access your location. Allow location access and retry, or enter coordinates manually.</div>
        <div className="card">
          <button className="btn btn-block" onClick={detect}>Retry location</button>
          <div className="section-title">Or enter coordinates</div>
          <form onSubmit={useManual}>
            <div className="grid-2">
              <div className="field"><label className="label">Latitude</label><input className="input" value={manualLat} onChange={(e)=>setManualLat(e.target.value)} placeholder="12.9716" /></div>
              <div className="field"><label className="label">Longitude</label><input className="input" value={manualLng} onChange={(e)=>setManualLng(e.target.value)} placeholder="77.5946" /></div>
            </div>
            <button className="btn btn-outline btn-block" type="submit">Find shops</button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!groups) return <Loading text="Finding shops near you…" />;

  const any = SECTIONS.some((s) => asArray(groups[s.key]).length > 0);

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <RoleWarning? no, keep mart clean.
      <div className="row-between">
        <h2 className="section-title" style={{margin:0}}>Shops near you</h2>
        <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={detect}>Refresh</button>
      </div>
      {!any && <EmptyState title="No open shops nearby">There are no open shops within 20 km of you right now.</EmptyState>}
      {SECTIONS.map((s) => {
        const shops = asArray(groups[s.key]);
        if (shops.length === 0) return null;
        return (
          <section key={s.key}>
            <h3 className="section-title">{s.title}</h3>
            <div className="grid">
              {shops.map((shop) => <ShopCard key={shop.id} shop={shop} />)}
            </div>
          </section>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function ShopCard({ shop }) {
  const distance = shop.distance_km ?? shop.distance;
  const open = shop.is_open ?? shop.open;
  return (
    <Link to={`/shops/${shop.id}`} className="card shop-card">
      <div className="row-between">
        <strong>{shop.name}</strong>
        {open !== undefined && <span className={`badge ${open ? 'badge-green' : 'badge-gray'}`}>{open ? 'Open' : 'Closed'}</span>}
      </div>
      {shop.address && <p className="muted small">{shop.address}</p>}
      {distance !== undefined && <p className="small" style={{color:'var(--green-dark)', fontWeight:700, margin:0}}>{Number(distance).toFixed(1)} km away</p>}
    </Link>
  );
}

Mart Shop page:

```jsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, apiError } from '../lib/api';
import { useToast } from '../lib/toast';
import { useCart } from '../lib/cart';
import { Loading, EmptyState, formatINR, asArray } from '../lib/components';

export default function Shop() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { cart, add, setQty, clear } = useCart();
  const [shop, setShop] = useState(null);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [shopRes, prodRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get(`/shops/${id}`),
        api.get('/products', { params: { shop_id: id } }),
      ]);
      setShop(shopRes.data?.shop || shopRes.data);
      setProducts(asArray(prodRes.data, ['products']));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load this shop'), 'error');
      setProducts([]);
    }
  }, [id, toast]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  function qtyOf(productId) {
    const line = cart.items.find((i) => String(i.product.id) === String(productId));
    return line ? line.qty : 0;
  }

  function handleAdd(product) {
    if (cart.shopId && String(cart.shopId) !== String(id)) {
      if (!window.confirm(`Your cart has items from ${cart.shopName || 'another shop'}. Replace them with items from this shop?`)) return;
      clear();
    }
    add(product, { id, name: shop?.name });
  }

  if (!products) return <Loading text="Loading products…" />;

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      {shop && (
        <div className="card">
          <div className="row-between">
            <h2 style={{margin:0}}>{shop.name}</h2>
            {shop.is_open !== undefined && <span className={`badge ${shop.is_open ? 'badge-green':'badge-gray'}`}>{shop.is_open ? 'Open':'Closed'}</span>}
          </div>
          {shop.address && <p className="muted" style={{margin:0}}>{shop.address}</p>}
        </div>
      )}
      {products.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No products yet">This shop has not listed products yet.</EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid">
          {products.map((p) => {
            const qty = qtyOf(p.id);
            return (
              <div className="card product-card" key={p.id}>
                {p.image_url ? <img className="product-img" src={p.image_url} alt={p.name} /> : <div className="product-img product-img-placeholder">No image</div>}
                <div className="grow">
                  <strong>{p.name}</strong>
                  {p.category && <div className="muted small">{p.category}</div>}
                  <div className="price">{formatINR(p.price)}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:'flex', alignItems:'flex-end'}}>
                  {qty === 0 ? (
                    <button className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onClick={() => handleAdd(p)}>Add</button>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="stepper">
                      <button onClick={() => setQty(p.id, qty - 1)} aria-label="Decrease">−</button>
                      <span>{qty}</span>
                      <button onClick={() => handleAdd(p)} aria-label="Increase">+</button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      {cart.items.length > 0 && String(cart.shopId) === String(id) && (
        <Link to="/cart" className="btn btn-block">View cart ({cart.items.reduce((n,i)=>n+i.qty,0)})</Link>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

Cart context full:

```jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

const CartContext = createContext(null);
const KEY = 'lezzflow_mart_cart_v1';
const EMPTY = { shopId: null, shopName: '', items: [] };

export function CartProvider({ children }) {
  const [cart, setCart] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : EMPTY;
    } catch {
      return EMPTY;
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(cart)); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, [cart]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    cart,
    add(product, shop) {
      setCart((c) => {
        const base = String(c.shopId) === String(shop.id) ? c : { shopId: shop.id, shopName: shop.name || '', items: [] };
        const existing = base.items.find((i) => String(i.product.id) === String(product.id));
        const items = existing
          ? base.items.map((i) => (String(i.product.id) === String(product.id) ? { ...i, qty: i.qty + 1 } : i))
          : [...base.items, { product, qty: 1 }];
        return { ...base, items };
      });
    },
    setQty(productId, qty) {
      setCart((c) => ({
        ...c,
        items: qty <= 0 ? c.items.filter((i) => String(i.product.id) !== String(productId)) : c.items.map((i) => (String(i.product.id) === String(productId) ? { ...i, qty } : i)),
      }));
    },
    remove(productId) { ... },
    clear() { setCart(EMPTY); },
    count: cart.items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.qty, 0),
    total: cart.items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.qty * (Number(i.product.price) || 0), 0),
  }), [cart]);

  return <CartContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</CartContext.Provider>;
}

export function useCart() {
  return useContext(CartContext);
}

Mart Cart page:

```jsx
export default function Cart() {
  const { cart, setQty, remove, clear, total } = useCart();
  const [fulfillment, setFulfillment] = useState('delivery');
  const [placing, setPlacing] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  if (cart.items.length === 0) return <EmptyState title="Your cart is empty">Browse nearby shops and add products.</EmptyState>;

  async function placeOrder() {
    setPlacing(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        shop_id: cart.shopId,
        fulfillment,
        items: cart.items.map((i) => ({ product_id: i.product.id, quantity: i.qty, price: Number(i.product.price) || 0 })),
      };
      const { data } = await api.post('/orders', payload);
      const order = data?.order || data;
      const orderId = order?.id;
      if (fulfillment === 'delivery' && orderId) {
        try {
          await api.post(`/orders/${orderId}/assign-delivery`);
        } catch (err) {
          toast(apiError(err, 'Order placed, but delivery request could not be created yet'), 'error');
        }
      }
      clear();
      toast('Order placed successfully', 'success');
      navigate('/payment', { state: { orderId } });
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not place your order'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setPlacing(false);
    }
  }
  ...render items, fulfillment choices, place order button
}

const DOCS = [
  { key: 'aadhaar_url', label: 'Aadhaar card' },
  { key: 'pan_url', label: 'PAN card' },
  { key: 'license_url', label: 'Driving licence' },

export default function KycForm() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [urls, setUrls] = useState({ aadhaar_url: '', pan_url: '', license_url: '' });
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState({});
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function uploadDoc(key, file) {
    if (!file) return;
    setUploading((u) => ({ ...u, [key]: true }));
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', file);
      const { data } = await api.post('/upload', fd);
      if (data?.url) {
        setUrls((u) => ({ ...u, [key]: data.url }));
        toast('Document uploaded', 'success');
      } else {
        toast('Upload did not return a file URL', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Upload failed'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setUploading((u) => ({ ...u, [key]: false }));
    }
  }

  const ready = DOCS.every((d) => urls[d.key]);

  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!ready) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/kyc', { ...urls });
      toast('KYC submitted for review', 'success');
      navigate('/');
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not submit KYC'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }
  ...
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../lib/auth';
import { apiError } from '../lib/api';

export default function Login() {
  const { firebaseUser, loading, signIn } = useAuth();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  if (!loading && firebaseUser) return <Navigate to="/" replace />;

  async function handleSignIn() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await signIn();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(apiError(err, 'Sign-in failed. Please try again.'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="login-wrap">
      <div className="login-card">
        <img src="/lezzflow-horizontal-dark.png" alt="LezzFlow" className="login-logo" />
        <h2>LezzFlow Seller</h2>
        <p className="muted">Manage your shop, products and orders.</p>
        {error && <div className="banner banner-error" style={{marginBottom:12}}>{error}</div>}
        <button className="google-btn" onClick={handleSignIn} disabled={busy || loading}>
          <GoogleIcon /> {busy ? 'Signing in…' : 'Continue with Google'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function GoogleIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true">
      <path fill="#FFC107" d="M43.6 20.1H42V20H24v8h11.3C33.7 32.7 29.2 36 24 36c-6.6 0-12-5.4-12-12s5.4-12 12-12c3.1 0 5.9 1.2 8 3l5.7-5.7C34 6.1 29.3 4 24 4 13 4 4 13 4 24s9 20 20 20 20-9 20-20c0-1.3-.1-2.6-.4-3.9z"/>
      <path fill="#FF3D00" d="M6.3 14.7l6.6 4.8C14.7 15.1 19 12 24 12c3.1 0 5.9 1.2 8 3l5.7-5.7C34 6.1 29.3 4 24 4 16.3 4 9.7 8.3 6.3 14.7z"/>
      <path fill="#4CAF50" d="M24 44c5.2 0 9.9-2 13.4-5.2l-6.2-5.2C29.2 35.1 26.7 36 24 36c-5.2 0-9.6-3.3-11.3-8l-6.5 5C9.5 39.6 16.2 44 24 44z"/>
      <path fill="#1976D2" d="M43.6 20.1H42V20H24v8h11.3c-.8 2.2-2.2 4.2-4.1 5.6l6.2 5.2C36.9 39.2 44 34 44 24c0-1.3-.1-2.6-.4-3.9z"/>

}

export default function ShopForm() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const isEdit = Boolean(id);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', address: '', phone: '', lat: '', lng: '', is_open: true });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEdit);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEdit) return;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { data } = await api.get(`/shops/${id}`);
        const s = data?.shop || data;
        setForm({
          name: s.name || '',
          address: s.address || '',
          phone: s.phone || '',
          lat: s.lat ?? s.latitude ?? '',
          lng: s.lng ?? s.longitude ?? '',
          is_open: s.is_open ?? true,
        });
      } catch (err) {
        toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load shop'), 'error');
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [id, isEdit, toast]);

  function captureLocation() {
    if (!('geolocation' in navigator)) { toast('Geolocation is not supported on this device', 'error'); return; }
    setLocating(true);
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        setForm((f) => ({ ...f, lat: pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6), lng: pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6) }));
        setLocating(false);
        toast('Location captured', 'success');
      },
      () => { setLocating(false); toast('Could not get your location. You can enter coordinates manually.', 'error'); },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 12000 }
    );
  }

  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: form.name.trim(),
        address: form.address.trim(),
        phone: form.phone.trim() || undefined,
        lat: form.lat === '' ? undefined : Number(form.lat),
        lng: form.lng === '' ? undefined : Number(form.lng),
        is_open: Boolean(form.is_open),
      };
      if (isEdit) await api.put(`/shops/${id}`, payload);
      else await api.post('/shops', payload);
      toast(isEdit ? 'Shop updated' : 'Shop created', 'success');
      navigate('/');
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not save shop'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }
  ...
}

export function Shell({ appName, links = [], wide = false, children }) {
  const { user, firebaseUser, signOut } = useAuth();
  const displayName = user?.name || firebaseUser?.displayName || '';
  return (
    <div className="shell">
      <header className="topbar">
        <div className="topbar-inner">
          <img src="/lezzflow-horizontal-dark.png" alt="LezzFlow" className="brand-logo" />
          <span className="app-tag">{appName}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="topbar-actions">
          {displayName ? <span className="user-name">{displayName}</span> : null}
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={signOut}>Sign out</button>
        </div>
      </header>
      {links.length > 0 && (
        <nav className="nav">
          {links.map((l) => (
            <NavLink key={l.to} to={l.to} end={Boolean(l.end)} className={({ isActive }) => `nav-link${isActive ? ' active' : ''}`}>
              {l.label}
            </NavLink>
          ))}
        </nav>
      )}
      <main className={`content${wide ? ' wide' : ''}`}>
        <RoleWarning />
        {children}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copies LezzFlow brand assets into each app's public/ folder.
# Usage: bash scripts/copy-logos.sh [path-to-lezzflow-logos]
set -euo pipefail

SRC="${1:-/home/hatch/workspace/lezzflow-logos}"
FILES=("lezzflow-icon.png" "lezzflow-horizontal-dark.png" "lezzflow-horizontal-light.png" "favicon.png")

for app in seller mart partner admin; do

  mkdir -p "$dest"
  for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
    if [ -f "${SRC}/${f}" ]; then
      cp "${SRC}/${f}" "${dest}/${f}"
    else
      echo "warning: ${SRC}/${f} not found" >&2
    fi
  done
done
echo "Logo assets copied into apps/*/public/"

```jsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { NavLink, Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from './auth';

/* ---------- Toasts ---------- */
const ToastContext = createContext({ toast: () => {} });

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const toast = useCallback((message, type = 'info') => {
    const id = ++idRef.current;
    setToasts((list) => [...list, { id, message, type }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts((list) => list.filter((t) => t.id !== id)), 4200);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ toast }}>
      {children}
      <div className="toast-wrap" aria-live="polite">
        {toasts.map((t) => (
          <div key={t.id} className={`toast toast-${t.type}`}>{t.message}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() {
  return useContext(ToastContext);
}

/* ---------- Layout ---------- */
export function Shell({ appName, links = [], wide = false, children }) { ... }

export function RequireAuth({ children }) { ... }

export function RoleWarning() { ... }

/* ---------- UI bits ---------- */
export function Loading({ text = 'Loading…' }) { ... }
export function EmptyState({ title, children }) { ... }
export function StatusBadge({ status }) { ... }

/* ---------- Helpers ---------- */
export function asArray(data, keys = []) { ... }
export function firstDefined(...vals) { ... }
export function formatINR(value) { ... }
export function formatDate(value) { ... }
```

import { auth, googleProvider } from './firebase';

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children, expectedRole }) {
  const [firebaseUser, setFirebaseUser] = useState(null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [verifyError, setVerifyError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (u) => {
      setFirebaseUser(u);
      setVerifyError(null);
      if (u) {
        try {
          const idToken = await u.getIdToken();
          const { data } = await api.post('/auth/verify', { idToken });
          setProfile(data || null);
        } catch (err) {
          setProfile(null);
          setVerifyError(err?.response?.data?.error || err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Account verification failed');
        }
      } else {
        setProfile(null);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  const signIn = useCallback(async () => {
    await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
  }, []);

  const signOut = useCallback(async () => {
    await firebaseSignOut(auth);
    setProfile(null);
  }, []);

  const value = {
    firebaseUser,
    profile,
    user: profile?.user || null,
    role: profile?.role || profile?.user?.role || null,
    expectedRole,
    loading,
    verifyError,
    signIn,
    signOut,
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  return useContext(AuthContext);
}

export function RoleWarning() {
  const { role, expectedRole, verifyError } = useAuth();
  if (verifyError) {
    return <div className="banner banner-error">Could not verify your account with the server: {verifyError}</div>;
  }
  if (expectedRole && role && role !== expectedRole) {
    return (
      <div className="banner banner-warn">
        Your account is registered as “{role}”. Some {expectedRole} features may be unavailable until your account has the “{expectedRole}” role.
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
}

```jsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, apiError } from '../lib/api';
import { EmptyState, Loading, asArray, formatINR, useToast } from '../lib/components';

export default function Products() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [shops, setShops] = useState(null);
  const [shopId, setShopId] = useState(searchParams.get('shop') || '');
  const [products, setProducts] = useState(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const { data } = await api.get('/shops', { params: { mine: 'true' } });
        const list = asArray(data, ['shops']);
        setShops(list);
        setShopId((current) => current || (list.length > 0 ? String(list[0].id) : ''));
      } catch (err) {
        toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load your shops'), 'error');
        setShops([]);
      }
    })();
  }, [toast]);

  const loadProducts = useCallback(async (id) => {
    if (!id) { setProducts([]); return; }
    try {
      const { data } = await api.get('/products', { params: { shop_id: id } });
      setProducts(asArray(data, ['products']));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load products'), 'error');
      setProducts([]);
    }
  }, [toast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (shops === null) return;
    setProducts(null);
    loadProducts(shopId);
  }, [shopId, shops, loadProducts]);

  async function removeProduct(product) {
    if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${product.name}"? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
    setDeleting(product.id);
    try {
      await api.delete(`/products/${product.id}`);
      toast('Product deleted', 'success');
      loadProducts(shopId);
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not delete product'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(null);
    }
  }

  if (shops === null) return <Loading text="Loading your shops…" />;
  if (shops.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="card center-card">
        <h2>Create your shop first</h2>
        <p className="muted">You need a shop before you can add products.</p>
        <Link to="/shop/new" className="btn btn-block">Create shop</Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      <div className="row-between">
        {shops.length > 1 ? (
          <select className="select" style={{ maxWidth: 220 }} value={shopId} onChange={(e) => setShopId(e.target.value)}>
            {shops.map((s) => <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name}</option>)}
          </select>
        ) : (
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0 }}>Products</h2>
        )}
        <Link to={`/products/new?shop=${shopId}`} className="btn btn-sm">Add product</Link>
      </div>
      {products === null ? (
        <Loading text="Loading products…" />
      ) : products.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No products yet">Add your first product with the AI scanner, a barcode, or manual entry.</EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid">
          {products.map((p) => (
            <div className="card product-card" key={p.id}>
              {p.image_url ? (
                <img className="product-img" src={p.image_url} alt={p.name} />
              ) : (
                <div className="product-img product-img-placeholder">No image</div>
              )}
              <div className="grow">
                <strong>{p.name}</strong>
                {p.category ? <div className="muted small">{p.category}</div> : null}
                <div className="price">{formatINR(p.price)}</div>
                {p.stock !== undefined && p.stock !== null ? <div className="muted small">Stock: {p.stock}</div> : null}
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6, justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                <Link className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" to={`/products/${p.id}/edit?shop=${shopId}`}>Edit</Link>
                <button className="btn btn-danger btn-sm" disabled={deleting === p.id} onClick={() => removeProduct(p)}>
                  {deleting === p.id ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```jsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, apiError } from '../lib/api';
import { EmptyState? not needed, Loading, asArray, useToast } from '../lib/components';

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [shops, setShops] = useState(null);
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.get('/shops', { params: { mine: 'true' } });
      setShops(asArray(data, ['shops']));
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load your shops'), 'error');
      setShops([]);
    }
  }, [toast]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  async function toggleOpen(shop) {
    setToggling(shop.id);
    try {
      await api.put(`/shops/${shop.id}`, { ...shop, is_open: !shop.is_open });
      toast(shop.is_open ? 'Shop marked as closed' : 'Shop is now open', 'success');
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Could not update shop'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setToggling(null);
    }
  }

  if (shops === null) return <Loading text="Loading your shop…" />;

  if (shops.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="card center-card">
        <h2>Set up your shop</h2>
        <p className="muted">Create your shop profile to start selling to customers nearby.</p>
        <Link className="btn btn-block" to="/shop/new">Create shop</Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="stack">
      {shops.map((shop) => {
        const open = Boolean(shop.is_open);
        return (
          <div className="card" key={shop.id}>
            <div className="row-between">
              <h2 style={{ margin: 0 }}>{shop.name}</h2>
              <span className={`badge ${open ? 'badge-green' : 'badge-gray'}`}>{open ? 'Open' : 'Closed'}</span>
            </div>
            {shop.address ? <p className="muted">{shop.address}</p> : null}
            {(shop.lat !== undefined && shop.lng !== undefined && shop.lat !== null) ? (
              <p className="muted small">Location: {shop.lat}, {shop.lng}</p>
            ) : null}
            <div className="row wrap" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
              <button className="btn btn-sm" disabled={toggling === shop.id} onClick={() => toggleOpen(shop)}>
                {toggling === shop.id ? 'Updating…' : open ? 'Mark closed' : 'Mark open'}
              </button>
              <Link className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" to={`/shop/${shop.id}/edit`}>Edit shop</Link>
              <Link className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" to={`/products?shop=${shop.id}`}>Products</Link>
              <Link className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" to="/orders">Orders</Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      <Link className="btn btn-outline" to="/shop/new">Add another shop</Link>
    </div>
  );
}

        toast(apiError(err, 'Could not load your shops'), 'error');
        setShops([]);
      }
    })();

          price: p.price ?? '',
          stock: p.stock ?? '',
          image_url: p.image_url || '',
        });
        if (p.shop_id) setShopId(String(p.shop_id));

      const { data } = await api.post('/scan/ai', fd);
      setForm((f) => ({
        ...f,
        name: data?.name || f.name,
        category: data?.category || f.category,
        description: data?.description || f.description,
      }));
      toast('Product details filled by AI — review and save', 'success');
      setMethod('manual');
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'AI scan failed'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setScanning(false);
    }
  }

  async function lookupBarcode(code) {
    const value = (code || '').trim();
    if (!value) return;
    setLookingUp(true);

      const { data } = await api.post('/scan/barcode', { code: value });

        toast('Product found — review and save', 'success');
        setMethod('manual');

        toast('No product found for that barcode. Fill in the details manually.', 'info');
        setMethod('manual');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast(apiError(err, 'Barcode lookup failed'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setLookingUp(false);
    }
  }

  async function uploadImage(e) {

      const fd = new FormData();

      if (data?.url) {
        update('image_url', data.url);
        toast('Image uploaded', 'success');
      } else {
        toast('Upload did not return an image URL', 'error');

import axios from 'axios'

const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: `${API_URL}/api`,
})

let tokenProvider = null

export function setTokenProvider(fn) {
  tokenProvider = fn
}

api.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
  if (tokenProvider) {
    const token = await tokenProvider()
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
    }
  }
  return config
})

export default api

**src/AuthContext.jsx:**
```jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { onIdTokenChanged } from 'firebase/auth'
import { auth } from './firebase'
import api, { setTokenProvider } from './api'

const AuthContext = createContext(null)

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [firebaseUser, setFirebaseUser] = useState(null)
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)   // backend user {..., role}
  const [role, setRole] = useState(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    setTokenProvider(async () => {
      const u = auth.currentUser
      if (!u) return null
      return u.getIdToken()
    })

    const unsub = onIdTokenChanged(auth, async (fbUser) => {
      setFirebaseUser(fbUser)
      if (fbUser) {
        try {
          const idToken = await fbUser.getIdToken()
          const res = await api.post('/auth/verify', { idToken })
          setUser(res.data.user)
          setRole(res.data.role)
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('verify failed', err)
          setUser(null)
          setRole(null)
        }
      } else {
        setUser(null)
        setRole(null)
      }
      setLoading(false)
    })
    return unsub
  }, [])

  const value = { firebaseUser, user, role, loading }
  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>
}

export function useAuth() {
  return useContext(AuthContext)
}
```

// Toast.jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react'

const ToastContext = createContext(null)

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([])
  const show = useCallback((message, type = 'info') => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random()
    setToasts(t => [...t, { id, message, type }])
    setTimeout(() => setToasts(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id)), 3500)
  }, [])
  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={show}>
      {children}
      <div className="toast-host">
        {toasts.map(t => <div key={t.id} className={`toast toast-${t.type}`}>{t.message}</div>)}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  )
}

export function useToast() {
  return useContext(ToastContext)
}
```

import axios from 'axios'

const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: `${API_URL}/api`,
  timeout: 30000,
})

let getToken = null

export function setTokenGetter(fn) {
  getToken = fn
}

api.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
  if (getToken) {
    try {
      const token = await getToken()
      if (token) config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
    } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return config
})

export function getErrorMessage(err, fallback = 'Something went wrong') {
  return err?.response?.data?.error || err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || fallback
}

export default api

Let me write AuthContext:

```jsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { onIdTokenChanged } from 'firebase/auth'
import { auth } from './firebase'
import api, { setTokenGetter, getErrorMessage } from './api'

const AuthContext = createContext(null)

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [firebaseUser, setFirebaseUser] = useState(null)
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)
  const [role, setRole] = useState(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [verifyError, setVerifyError] = useState(null)

  const verify = useCallback(async (fbUser) => {
    setVerifyError(null)
    try {
      const idToken = await fbUser.getIdToken()
      const res = await api.post('/auth/verify', { idToken })
      setUser(res.data.user || null)
      setRole(res.data.role || res.data.user?.role || null)
    } catch (err) {
      setUser(null)
      setRole(null)
      setVerifyError(getErrorMessage(err, 'Could not verify your account'))
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    setTokenGetter(() => {
      const u = auth.currentUser
      return u ? u.getIdToken() : null
    })
    const unsubscribe = onIdTokenChanged(auth, async (fbUser) => {
      setFirebaseUser(fbUser)
      if (fbUser) {
        await verify(fbUser)
      } else {
        setUser(null)
        setRole(null)
        setVerifyError(null)
      }
      setLoading(false)
    })
    return unsubscribe
  }, [verify])

  const retryVerify = useCallback(() => {
    if (auth.currentUser) return verify(auth.currentUser)
  }, [verify])

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ firebaseUser, user, role, loading, verifyError, retryVerify }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  )
}

export function useAuth() {
  return useContext(AuthContext)
}
```

**ProtectedRoute.jsx:**

```jsx
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useAuth } from '../AuthContext'
import { signOutUser } from '../firebase'
import Loading from './Loading'

export default function ProtectedRoute({ children }) {
  const { firebaseUser, role, loading, verifyError, retryVerify } = useAuth()

  if (loading) return <Loading full />

  if (!firebaseUser) return <Navigate to="/login" replace />

  if (verifyError) {
    return (
      <div className="center-page">
        <div className="card center-card">
          <h2>Connection problem</h2>
          <p className="muted">{verifyError}</p>
          <button className="btn btn-primary btn-block" onClick={retryVerify}>Try again</button>
          <button className="btn btn-outline btn-block" onClick={signOutUser}>Sign out</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (role && role !== 'seller') {
    return (
      <div className="center-page">
        <div className="card center-card">
          <h2>Seller access only</h2>
          <p className="muted">This account is registered as “{role}”. Please sign in with a seller account.</p>
          <button className="btn btn-primary btn-block" onClick={signOutUser}>Switch account</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return children
}
```

- Shop (storefront): `<path d="M4 9l1-5h14l1 5"/><path d="M4 9h16v11H4z"/><path d="M9 20v-6h6v6"/>` — ok-ish.

Use stroke="currentColor" fill="none" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round".

import { Routes, Route, Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'
import Header from './components/Header'
import BottomNav from './components/BottomNav'
import ProtectedRoute from './components/ProtectedRoute'
import Login from './pages/Login'
import Dashboard from './pages/Dashboard'
import Shop from './pages/Shop'
import Products from './pages/Products'
import ProductForm from './pages/ProductForm'
import Orders from './pages/Orders'
import { useAuth } from './AuthContext'

export default function App() {
  const { firebaseUser, loading } = useAuth()
  const location = useLocation()
  const showChrome = firebaseUser && location.pathname !== '/login'

  return (
    <div className="app-shell">
      {showChrome && <Header />}
      <main className="app-main">
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
          <Route path="/" element={<ProtectedRoute><Dashboard /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/shop" element={<ProtectedRoute><Shop /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/products" element={<ProtectedRoute><Products /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/products/new" element={<ProtectedRoute><ProductForm /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/products/:id/edit" element={<ProtectedRoute><ProductForm /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/orders" element={<ProtectedRoute><Orders /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
        </Routes>
      </main>
      {showChrome && <BottomNav />}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import api, { getErrorMessage } from '../api'
import { useAuth } from '../AuthContext'
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast'
import Loading from '../components/Loading'

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const toast = useToast()
  const [shop, setShop] = useState(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState(false)
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState({ products: 0, orders: 0 })

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/shops')
      const shops = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data.shops || []
      const myShop = shops[0] || null
      setShop(myShop)
      if (myShop) {
        const [p, o] = await Promise.allSettled([api.get('/products'), api.get('/orders')])
        setCounts({
          products: p.status === 'fulfilled' ? (Array.isArray(p.value.data) ? p.value.data.length : p.value.data.products?.length || 0) : 0,
          orders: o.status === 'fulfilled' ? (Array.isArray(o.value.data) ? o.value.data.length : o.value.data.orders?.length || 0) : 0,
        })
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error')
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [toast])

  useEffect(() => { load() }, [load])

  async function toggleOpen() {
    if (!shop) return
    setToggling(true)
    try {
      const updated = { ...shop, is_open: !shop.is_open }
      const res = await api.put(`/shops/${shop.id}`, updated)
      setShop(res.data || updated)
      toast(updated.is_open ? 'Shop is now Open' : 'Shop is now Closed', 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      toast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error')
    } finally {
      setToggling(false)
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <Loading />

  if (!shop) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div className="hero-card card">
          <h1>Namaste{user?.name ? `, ${user.name.split(' ')[0]}` : ''} 👋</h1>
          <p className="muted">Set up your shop to start selling to customers nearby.</p>
          <Link to="/shop" className="btn btn-primary btn-block">Create your shop</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <h1 className="page-title">Dashboard</h1>
      <div className="card shop-card">
        <div className="shop-card-top">
          <div>
            <h2 className="shop-name">{shop.name}</h2>
            <p className="muted">{shop.address}</p>
          </div>
          <span className={`badge ${shop.is_open ? 'badge-green' : 'badge-grey'}`}>
            {shop.is_open ? 'Open' : 'Closed'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <label className="switch-row">
          <span>{shop.is_open ? 'Accepting orders' : 'Not accepting orders'}</span>
          <span className={`switch ${shop.is_open ? 'on' : ''} ${toggling ? 'disabled' : ''}`} onClick={!toggling ? toggleOpen : undefined} role="switch" aria-checked={!!shop.is_open} tabIndex={0}>
            <span className="knob" />
          </span>
        </label>
        <Link to="/shop" className="btn btn-outline btn-block">Edit shop details</Link>
      </div>

      <div className="stat-grid">
        <Link to="/products" className="card stat-card">
          <span className="stat-num">{counts.products}</span>
          <span className="muted">Products</span>
        </Link>
        <Link to="/orders" className="card stat-card">
          <span className="stat-num">{counts.orders}</span>
          <span className="muted">Orders</span>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className="quick-actions">
        <Link to="/products/new" className="btn btn-primary btn-block">+ Add product</Link>
        <Link to="/orders" className="btn btn-outline btn-block">View orders</Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import api, { getErrorMessage } from '../api'
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast'
import Loading from '../components/Loading'

export default function Shop() {
  const toast = useToast()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false)
  const [shopId, setShopId] = useState(null)
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', address: '', lat: '', lng: '', is_open: true })

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await api.get('/shops')
        const shops = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data.shops || []
        const s = shops[0]
        if (s) {
          setShopId(s.id)
          setForm({
            name: s.name || '',
            address: s.address || '',
            lat: s.lat ?? '',
            lng: s.lng ?? '',
            is_open: s.is_open !== false,
          })
        }
      } catch (err) {
        toast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error')
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    })()
  }, [toast])

  function update(field, value) {
    setForm(f => ({ ...f, [field]: value }))
  }

  function useMyLocation() {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      toast('Geolocation is not supported on this device', 'error')
      return
    }
    setLocating(true)
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        setForm(f => ({ ...f, lat: pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6), lng: pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6) }))
        setLocating(false)
        toast('Location captured', 'success')
      },
      (err) => {
        setLocating(false)
        toast(err.message || 'Could not get location', 'error')
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
    )
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!form.name.trim()) return toast('Please enter a shop name', 'error')
    if (!form.address.trim()) return toast('Please enter a shop address', 'error')
    setSaving(true)
    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      address: form.address.trim(),
      lat: form.lat === '' ? null : Number(form.lat),
      lng: form.lng === '' ? null : Number(form.lng),
      is_open: !!form.is_open,
    }
    try {
      if (shopId) {
        await api.put(`/shops/${shopId}`, payload)
        toast('Shop updated', 'success')
      } else {
        await api.post('/shops', payload)
        toast('Shop created', 'success')
      }
      navigate('/')
    } catch (err) {
      toast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <Loading />

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <h1 className="page-title">{shopId ? 'Manage shop' : 'Create your shop'}</h1>
      <form className="card form-card" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="shop-name">Shop name</label>
          <input id="shop-name" type="text" value={form.name} onChange={e => update('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Sharma Kirana Store" required />
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label htmlFor="shop-address">Address</label>
          <textarea id="shop-address" rows="3" value={form.address} onChange={e => update('address', e.target.value)} placeholder="Shop no, street, area, city" required />
        </div>
        <div className="field">
          <label>GPS location</label>
          <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={useMyLocation} disabled={locating}>
            {locating ? 'Locating…' : '📍 Use my current location'}
          </button>
          <div className="field-row">
            <input type="number" step="any" inputMode="decimal" value={form.lat} onChange={e => update('lat', e.target.value)} placeholder="Latitude" />
            <input type="number" step="any" inputMode="decimal" value={form.lng} onChange={e => update('lng', e.target.value)} placeholder="Longitude" />
          </div>
          <p className="hint">Customers discover your shop based on this location.</p>
        </div>
        <label className="switch-row">
          <span>Shop is open</span>
          <button type="button" className={`switch ${form.is_open ? 'on' : ''}`} onClick={() => update('is_open', !form.is_open)} role="switch" aria-checked={form.is_open}>
            <span className="knob" />
          </button>
        </label>
        <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary btn-block" disabled={saving}>
          {saving ? 'Saving…' : shopId ? 'Save changes' : 'Create shop'}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  )
}
```

**Products.jsx:**

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
import api, { getErrorMessage } from '../api'
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast'
import Loading from '../components/Loading'

export default function Products() {
  const toast = useToast()
  const [shop, setShop] = useState(null)
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState(null)

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const shopRes = await api.get('/shops')
      const shops = Array.isArray(shopRes.data) ? shopRes.data : shopRes.data.shops || []
      const s = shops[0] || null
      setShop(s)
      if (s) {
        const res = await api.get('/products')
        setProducts(Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data.products || [])
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error')
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [toast])

  useEffect(() => { load() }, [load])

  async function handleDelete(p) {
    if (!window.confirm(`Delete "${p.name}"?`)) return
    setDeletingId(p.id)
    try {
      await api.delete(`/products/${p.id}`)
      setProducts(list => list.filter(x => x.id !== p.id))
      toast('Product deleted', 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      toast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error')
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null)
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <Loading />

  if (!shop) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div className="card empty-card">
          <p>Create your shop first, then add products.</p>
          <Link to="/shop" className="btn btn-primary btn-block">Set up shop</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-head">
        <h1 className="page-title">Products</h1>
        <Link to="/products/new" className="btn btn-primary btn-sm">+ Add</Link>
      </div>
      {products.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card empty-card">
          <p className="empty-emoji">📦</p>
          <p>No products yet.</p>
          <p className="muted">Add your first product with the AI scanner, a barcode, or manually.</p>
          <Link to="/products/new" className="btn btn-primary btn-block">Add product</Link>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="product-list">
          {products.map(p => (
            <li key={p.id} className="card product-card">
              <div className="product-thumb">
                {p.image_url || p.image ? <img src={p.image_url || p.image} alt={p.name} /> : <span>🛍️</span>}
              </div>
              <div className="product-info">
                <p className="product-name">{p.name}</p>
                {p.category && <p className="muted small">{p.category}</p>}
                <p className="product-meta">
                  <span className="price">₹{p.price}</span>
                  {p.stock != null && <span className="muted small"> · Stock: {p.stock}</span>}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="product-actions">
                <Link to={`/products/${p.id}/edit`} className="btn btn-outline btn-sm">Edit</Link>
                <button className="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onClick={() => handleDelete(p)} disabled={deletingId === p.id}>
                  {deletingId === p.id ? '…' : 'Delete'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
